name: selfhosted-grid-migration-skill
description: Migrate test automation from self-hosted Selenium Grid, docker-selenium, Selenoid, Aerokube Moon, Zalenium, and local Playwright/Puppeteer/Cypress/TestCafe/Appium to TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest) in any language or framework. Covers localhost:4444 Selenium Grid, docker-selenium images, Selenoid (selenoid:options), Moon (moon:options, Playwright/Puppeteer endpoints), Zalenium, and tests that launch browsers or Appium locally. Use this whenever someone wants to move, switch, port, migrate or point tests from self-hosted grids and local runners to TestMu AI or LambdaTest, asks what the TestMu or LT:Options equivalent is for a capability, config, CLI flag or API from self-hosted grids and local runners, mentions localhost:4444, selenium-hub, selenium/standalone-chrome, SE_NODE_MAX_SESSIONS, selenoid:options, enableVNC, moon:options, aerokube, or wants a migration plan, estimate, PR or checklist for a repo currently on self-hosted grids and local runners, even without the word migrate.
